Game Overview

In Deca vs Rooko, the core idea is straightforward: leap into a vibrant 2D adventure as Deca, a fearless robot collecting hotdogs across eight treacherous levels. Navigate deadly traps and fierce foes with skillful double jumps. Master quick reflexes and strategic moves to conquer escalating challenges that keep the excitement alive till the end.
